name: smith staggered stance romanian deadlift
description: A Romanian deadlift in a staggered stance on the smith machine. It focuses on the hamstrings and glutes of the front leg.
instructions: Stand under the smith bar with one foot slightly behind the other.
Grip the bar and unrack it.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back and the bar close to your legs.
Lower until you feel a stretch in the hamstrings.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Switch which foot is forward after your set.
